{'text': '警務處國家安全處今日（9日）直接出稿，表示三個月前曾拘捕一名52歲男子，並在前日（10月7日）落案起訴他一項「明知而發布具煽動意圖的刊物」罪。據《法庭線》報道，被告名字為羅耀輝。', 'translation': 'Police National Security Department today (9th) issued a direct press release stating that three months ago they had arrested a 52-year-old man, and on the day before yesterday (7th October) charged him with one count of "publishing a publication with seditious intent knowing it had such intent". According to a report by The Court News (法庭線), the defendant\'s name is Lo Yiu-fai (羅耀輝).'}

{'text': '政府今日出稿指，國安處在7月9日，在東區拘捕一名52歲本地男子，指他涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》第24條，「明知而發布具煽動意圖的刊物」罪。', 'translation': 'The government issued a press release today stating that the National Security Department arrested a 52-year-old local man in the Eastern District on 9th July, alleging that he had violated Article 24 of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance (《維護國家安全條例》) — the offence of "publishing a publication with seditious intent knowing it had such intent".'}

{'text': '警方指，被捕男子涉嫌多次透過網上社交平台，發布具有煽動意圖信息，內容包括引起他人對國家及香港特區政府和司法機構的憎恨，及煽惑他人企圖不循合法途徑，改變特區依法制定的事項。', 'translation': 'Police said the arrested man was suspected of repeatedly posting messages with seditious intent via online social media platforms. The content included inciting hatred towards the country and the Hong Kong SAR government and judiciary, and inciting others to attempt to alter matters lawfully established by the SAR through illegitimate means.'}

{'text': '該52歲男子被捕近三個月，警方在10月7日落案控告他一項「明知而發布具煽動意圖的刊物」罪。當日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。據《法庭線》報道，被告名字為羅耀輝，案件押後至12月15日再訊。', 'translation': 'The 52-year-old man had been held in custody for nearly three months after his arrest before police formally charged him on 7th October with one count of "publishing a publication with seditious intent knowing it had such intent". He appeared at the West Kowloon Magistrates\' Courts on the same day. According to The Court News, the defendant\'s name is Lo Yiu-fai (羅耀輝), and the case was adjourned to 15th December for further mention.'}

{'text': '近期國安警涉及煽動罪的執法，包括在9月30日，拘捕李盈姿、網媒爆炸頭創辦人鄧浩榮、他們指涉及今年8月31日在太子站外煽動，同一案件，國安警前後三次執法，共拘捕八人。', 'translation': 'Recent enforcement actions by national security police in connection with sedition offences include the arrest on 30th September of Lee Ying-chi (李盈姿) and Tang Ho-wing (鄧浩榮), founder of online media Explosion Head (爆炸頭). They are alleged to have been involved in seditious acts outside Prince Edward station on 31st August this year. For the same case, national security police conducted enforcement operations on three occasions, arresting a total of eight people.'}

{'text': '本周二（6日），國安警口在九龍拘捕一男一女，兩人被指涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》第24條「出於煽動意圖作出一項具煽動意圖的作為」罪。兩人年齡都是38歲，男子為一名持牌保險經紀，他被指涉嫌於社交平台營運專頁，專頁上發布的帖文，被指煽動他人對特區憲制秩序憎恨。被捕男子有銷售保險產品。據報，兩名被捕人為前「北區動源」成員黃嘉浩，及其女友人。據報兩人曾成立社交媒體專頁「黃式保險（YellowInsurance）」。', 'translation': 'On Tuesday (6th) of this week, national security police arrested a man and a woman in Kowloon. The two are alleged to have violated Article 24 of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance — the offence of "doing an act with seditious intent". Both are aged 38. The male is a licensed insurance broker, who was suspected of running a page on a social media platform; posts on the page were alleged to have incited others to hatred towards the SAR\'s constitutional order. The arrested man had sold insurance products. According to reports, the two arrested persons are Wong Ka-ho (黃嘉浩), a former member of "North District Progressiveness" (北區動源), and his girlfriend. It is reported that the two had set up a social media page called "Yellow Insurance" (黃式保險 / YellowInsurance).'}
